purpose: Observe simultaneous gate states on frozen same-scan inputs without changing fail-fast Formal behavior.

states.PASS: All required same-scan evidence is present and the frozen gate condition passes.
states.FAIL: All required same-scan evidence is present and the frozen gate condition fails.
states.UNKNOWN: Required evidence/provenance is missing or incomplete; never coerce to FAIL.
states.NOT_EVALUABLE: A conditional gate has no valid prerequisite state, e.g. RR when no target/channel exists.

design.formulas: Observer consumes exact derived values from the decision path where possible rather than rebuilding a second scoring engine.

durableSnapshotAudit.conclusion: Existing durable snapshot alone is insufficient for full gate-overlap inference; missing fields remain CAPTURE_GAP/UNKNOWN.

implementationBoundary.classA: Pure in-memory/offline observer + deterministic tests; zero new market calls; no Formal dependency.
implementationBoundary.classB: Persisting complete overlap receipts, earlier universe/history-admission receipts, immutable generation linkage or shared runtime schema.

prohibited: Using FAIL counts as marginal gate contribution
Changing Formal result from observer output

oneGateReplay.rule: Remove exactly one gate. Scan remaining gates in frozen Formal order. UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUABLE before a resolvable result blocks exact next-failure/acceptance attribution.
oneGateReplay.nextFailureCondition: Every earlier remaining gate PASS and then an observed FAIL.
prohibited: multi-gate removal attributed to one gate

evidence: V8.12 historyStructuralShape requires at least 60 prior bar dates before feature admission.
Current Fugle fetchHistoricalDaily filters null-close bars before they enter the normal cache path.
updateMarketState appends the current scan-date bar after admission, so the normal provider path has at least 61 close-valid rows at feature construction.
normalizeEnrichmentPayload still accepts payload.history overrides without equivalent value-schema validation, so absolute unreachability is not proven.
history60dReachability.interpretation: Do not use HISTORY_60D first-failure prevalence as a normal post-V8.12 strategy-scarcity mechanism. Retain it as defensive data-integrity coverage.

legacyDiagnosticsBoundary.persistence: v8_trade_journal_days.diagnostics_json is durable by scan_date but ON CONFLICT(scan_date) DO UPDATE, so it is latest same-date stored state, not immutable first-known evidence.
legacyDiagnosticsBoundary.reader: Current multi-day /api/journal reader omits diagnostics_json; detailed historical diagnostics exist in D1 but are not exposed by that reader.
